entry.title: Monday 5 October 2026 · weekly: 1 to read, 33 worth the title
entry.content:
Superconducting artificial atoms

  • 74 T Quantum memory in an effective $Λ$-type system using dynamic detuning control of a superconducting qubit pair
    Hsin Chang, Kai-I Chu, Ite A. Yu et al. · 2026-09-28
    Detuning two qubits half a wavelength apart on a mirrored line turns super/subradiant states into a Λ system that stores and releases itinerant photons.
  • 70 E Experimental quantum-computing-enhanced sensing using Grover's algorithm
    Mathieu Ouellet, Purnendu Sen, Xiangqin Wang et al. · 2026-09-28
    Grover search on one transmon plus cavity beats the plain sensing baseline for unknown-frequency signals beyond 10 MHz bandwidth, with growing advantage.
  • 66 TE Closing a single-copy gap to the Holevo bound with two-copy measurements
    Changhao Li · 2026-09-29
    A three-parameter model reaches the Holevo bound with two-copy measurements but not one; superconducting qubits demonstrate the two-copy advantage experimentally.
  • 62 E Cavity magnonics and bound states in the continuum with Bragg and anti-Bragg mirrors
    B. -Y. Wu, K. -P. Li, G. Chen et al. · 2026-09-28
    YIG-sphere arrays on open waveguides form Bragg and anti-Bragg cavities whose bound states in the continuum are mapped with a moving probe sphere.
  • 50 T Correlation Imaging via Hybrid Entanglement between Microwave Photons and Surface Acoustic Wave Phonons
    Yu-Yuan Chen, Ling-An Wu, Yu-xi Liu · 2026-10-01
    Proposes ghost imaging with entangled microwave photons and surface-acoustic phonons, exploiting their 10^5 wavelength ratio for huge magnification or demagnification.

Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 76 T Counterdiabatic quasi-Floquet control for the generation of entangled BICs using giant atoms
    Alexis R. Legón, Pedro Orellana, Ariel Norambuena · 2026-09-26

  • 74 T Rayleigh-Wood Threshold Controls Nonlinear Photon Correlations in Atomic Arrays
    Zai-Cheng Xiao, Li-Ping Yang · 2026-09-30

  • 70 T Negative quasiprobabilities redistribute (and complex ones reduce) the information in unabsorbed photons
    Jonte R. Hance · 2026-09-30
    For single photons no interferometer beats direct transmission per absorbed photon; Kirkwood-Dirac negativity only redistributes information.
  • 66 E Quantum Key Distribution with Entanglement-Swapped Photons from a Quantum Emitter
    Michele B. Rota, Francesco Basso Basset, Alessandro Laneve et al. · 2026-10-02
    Runs a source-independent QKD protocol on entanglement-swapped photons from a single GaAs quantum dot, the core step of a repeater.
  • 60 TE Optimal state detection without likelihood estimation
    M. D. K. Lee, Z. Chai, J. Z. F. Seng et al. · 2026-10-02
    Adaptive Bayesian fluorescence detection reduces to comparing elapsed time with two arithmetic deadlines, provably optimal in mean time.
  • 55 T Phase-sensitive avalanche quantum sensing of sub-shot-noise fields
    Nikolai D. Klimkin, Misha Ivanov · 2026-09-30
    Atoms pumped near a parity-forbidden cavity transition avalanche-amplify sub-shot-noise fields by 100 while keeping their phase.
  • 55 T Dynamic Sculpting of Photon Statistics in a Raman-Coupled Cavity QED System
    Amir Rahmani, Alireza Dehghani · 2026-09-27

    Morgan E. Choi, Daniel Allepuz-Requena, Diego Torres-Barajas et al. · 2026-09-29

    Kazufumi Tanji, Dot Belin Pio, Shohei Kiryu et al. · 2026-09-28

Foundations of quantum mechanics

    Lionel J. Dmello, Xiangling Xu, Marc-Olivier Renou et al. · 2026-10-02

    Hippolyte Dourdent, Andreas Leitherer, Emanuel-Cristian Boghiu et al. · 2026-09-30

  • 55 T Two-qutrit Werner state is always local

  • 54 T Indefinite causal order with output-signalling instruments
    Ricardo Silveira, Patrick Andriolo, Davide Poderini et al. · 2026-09-25

    Nasra Daher Ahmed, Ravi Kunjwal · 2026-09-30

  • 50 T What is Physics For? Why Classical Physics is not the Limit of Quantum Mechanics
    Adam Frank, Jacques L. Pienaar, Michel Bitbol et al. · 2026-09-28

Superconducting quantum computing

  • 68 T Optimal two-mode bosonic loss codes from finite group symmetry
    Argyris Giannisis Manes, Mahadevan Subramanian, Liang Jiang · 2026-09-30
    Finds finite-group symmetry behind optimal two-mode bosonic loss codes and constructs record-low-photon-number codes up to distance 10.
  • 62 E The QICK Box: A Modular RF Front-End System for Quantum Control and Readout
    L. Arnaldi, D. Martin, S. Sussman et al. · 2026-10-02
    Fermilab's open QICK Box front end reaches 91.7% single-shot readout on a six-transmon chip without a quantum amplifier.
  • 60 E Real-Time Adaptive Filtering and the Boxcar Limit in Superconducting Qubit Readout
    Hans Johnson, Tanay Roy, Leonardo Bove et al. · 2026-09-30
    Shows fixed FIR filters collapse to a scaled boxcar and give no readout-fidelity gain; template estimation cuts calibration shots tenfold.
  • 58 T Spiking neural networks for streaming qubit readout
    Barry M. Dillon, Aqib Javed, Jim Harkin et al. · 2026-10-01
    Spiking neural networks on FPGA give streaming qubit-state estimates that beat matched filters and approach full-trace neural nets.
  • 55 T All-Microwave Multiqubit Gates
    Guanqi Wang, Yao Song, Peng-Bo Li et al. · 2026-09-30
    Cross-resonance drives produce single-step multi-target gates; simulations reach three-qubit gates above 99.9% fidelity in 60 ns.
  • 50 T Parametric DRAG for leakage-suppressed exchange gates in superconducting qubits
    Yiwen Li, Xinsheng Tan, Yang Yu · 2026-09-29
    Parametric DRAG cancels both leakage paths in fast transmon exchange gates, cutting leakage by about 10^5 in Duffing simulations.
